description:
Route production event matching and identity reads through a body view, so the event type can become an envelope without one large atomic rewrite.

## Background

`Event` repeats `id` and `timestamp` in each of its variants (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1292-1616`), so `id()` (`:1621`), `assign_identity()` (`:1653`) and `get_issue_id()` (`:1989`) are full-width matches. Variant patterns `Event::<Variant>` occur in production at `domain/event_catalog.rs` (45 lines), `repository_state/mutation.rs`, `domain/queries.rs`, `domain/event_log.rs`, `storage/json.rs`, `storage/mod.rs`, `repository_state/archive.rs`, `domain/artifact_discovery.rs`, `domain/store_divergence.rs` and the commands `mod.rs`, `archive.rs`, `gate.rs`, `gate_check.rs`, `issue.rs`, `events.rs`, `worktree.rs`, `claim.rs` and `bulk_update.rs`. Production code also binds variant `timestamp` fields, for example `domain/queries.rs:79-95` and its doctest at `:54-64`. Replacing the enum with an envelope in one step rewrites about 260 lines in about 35 files at once.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A temporary `EventBody` alias for `Event`, the accessors `Event::body()`, `Event::into_body()` and `Event::timestamp()` beside `Event::id()`, and a `test_utils` helper that builds a stamped event from a body, an id and a timestamp exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: No production match outside `domain/types.rs` names `Event::<Variant>`; each matches `EventBody::<Variant>` on the body view.
- [hard] REQ-03: In production code and its doctests, no pattern binds `id` or `timestamp` from a variant, and no code outside `domain/types.rs` constructs a variant with those fields; constructions use draft constructors or the `test_utils` helper that stamps both.
- [hard] REQ-04: Event-log bytes and event command output are unchanged.

## Notes

The alias and accessors are a temporary bridge removed when the envelope lands in this epic (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`).
title: Production event matchers read events through a body view
